name: duocall
description: Get a real second opinion on a question that matters, from an AI of a DIFFERENT company, and then say honestly where the two agreed and where they did not. Finds a second AI program already installed and signed in on this computer; if there is none, hands the person the exact text to paste into a free chat in their browser and reads the reply back. Never claims the two agreed without quoting both, never merges two answers into one confident voice, and goes back for a second round only on the points that were actually in dispute. No keys, no accounts, no second subscription, nothing bought.
